rationale: Hurricane Isaias makes US Gulf Coast landfall killing four and leaving thousands without power; Riyadh airport attack raises Middle East tensions with potential oil market impact; Trump-Zelensky friction continues as rhetoric.

top_events.title: Four dead and thousands without power after Hurricane Isaias lashes US
top_events.label: Hurricane Isaias kills four on US Gulf Coast
top_events.summary: First Atlantic hurricane of 2026 season made landfall Friday evening, killing four people and ripping roofs off buildings before weakening to post-tropical cyclone.
